issue_context.title: fix output of ProgressPlugin
issue_context.body:
> Please then keep the conversation consistent, the problem described above has nothing to do with `ProgressPlugin`. Even if it has anything to do with it, this is a transitive effect of the problem, so let's find out what you want to get and what happens now. What is the problem?

@alexander-akait ProgressPlugin starts printing output before we call `run` or `watch` this caused confusion into thinking compilation has started early. 

we also have suspicions that "occasionally" it does indeed start and continue without calling `.run/watch` but no proof on that yet, we will try to rule it out.

_Originally posted by @serkanyersen in https://github.com/webpack/webpack/issues/12481#issuecomment-767095046_
